<thought>From the 13C NMR data, the signals at 134.30, 131.90, 128.20 (two signals), and 127.40 (two signals) fall within the typical aromatic carbon region (≈110–160 ppm). That accounts for 6 distinct aromatic carbon signals. The remaining signal at 168.20 ppm is outside this range (likely a carbonyl). Therefore, the molecule contains 6 aromatic carbons.</thought>
<final_answer>6</final_answer>
